title: Decent app
body:
I've downloaded loads of time blocking app to find one that suits me and this has been my favorite one yet. I enjoy how the time is listed as it helps to visualize all the time you have in the day, as well an easily add plans and move them around as your day goes.

However, the design of the app feels clunky and not modern, which keeps me from wanting to use the app after having it (not a vibe with my day).

So sadly I'll have to let it go. 

I hope they could do a revamp because I do love the function of this so much.

title: FINALLY found the BEST time blocking app
body: I have been searching high and low for the most convenient and simple to use time blocking planner, I am so happy to have found this app as it had many of the features that I wanted (+ free features) they have categories for each task, and with a super effecient interface where i can drag the tasks into the time blocks I want! I could also change the time intervals, colors and icons making this app super customisable :D I usually never write reviews so trust me on this, I got your backs :P and the developers your are superb!! (please sponsor me premium 💛)
author: eunice_avocado

title: Great time blocking app
body: One of, if not the best timeblocking app! The new update is sleek and functional, but I truly miss the feature that allowed me to swith the lists view on a whim w arrow buttons. Now it’s a dropdown to switch view, a lot more work! Perhaps future update can swipe to switch view instead if cumbersome dropdowns.
